t: Up 15% This Year, Is Costco Stock a Buy? - The Globe and Mail
s: 4 days ago - Even with tough comparisons when sales at Costco grew at abnormally high double-digit rates during COVID in both fiscal 2021 and fiscal 2022, sales growth has remained strong since. Sales in fiscal 2023, 2024, and 2025 rose 7%, 5%, and 8%, respectively. Despite the company's ability to consistently grow sales, I don't think the stock is a buy today -- especially after its 15% year-to-date gain.
